text.18:93: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.
text.18:94: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?
text.36:9: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
